detailed_description: 2D-animated, painterly anime background art with soft cel-shaded figures and clean thin dark-brown line art. [Shot 1] A wide shot from the far end of the counter at seated eye level, looking down the length of the room. The dark wooden café counter runs along the left third of the frame toward the back; behind it, about a third of the way in from the left edge, <Subject 2> stands facing screen right with his torso turned three-quarters toward the camera, head bowed slightly, both hands at waist height holding a white cup and a folded cloth, the cup inside the cloth. On the right, against the large rain-streaked café window, <Subject 3> sits alone at the small round wooden window table, seen side-on, facing screen left toward the room's back wall with her face turned to the window, both hands resting around a white cup on the table, her shoulders slightly drawn up in the navy duffle coat. The other small tables in the middle of the room each have two wooden chairs turned upside down on top of them, legs pointing at the ceiling. The two figures stand on the dark wood floor, the owner's feet hidden behind the counter, the girl's chair legs on the floor near the window wall. Warm amber light from glass pendant lamps fills the café; the street beyond the window is cold night blue, rain running down the glass in thin bright lines. The girl at the window is the brightest, cleanest figure in the frame, the owner smaller and further back.
